column5: picks the hardware program variant of the current EXT_vertex_shader (state key, hash chain lookup, rebuild via FUN_000546d0), flushes the constant allocation when needed, uploads the constants and refreshes the per-output enable words at glContext+0x18a0

clears the dirty masks of the variant constant bank (programData+0x750), fills it with the state constants (programFillStateConstants) or the fixed-function material/light matrix constants and marks every filled constant dirty

builds the variant-cache key from glContext+0x1804/0x44, looks up (or builds with the ffvp*PassThrough emitters and inserts) the fixed-function pass-through vertex program variant and makes it current
checks whether the fixed-function vertex program state tuple changed, looks up or builds (ffvpBuildProgram) the fixed-function program variant, makes it current and uploads its constants
copies the cached stream descriptor block of the current EXT_vertex_shader program into the context registers (glContext+0x1b9c.., 0x1be4, 0x1c04) and flags the stream state dirty
uploads every pending constant array, then (when the program changed) emits the stream setup packets and the constants with fog (vpUploadConstantsWithFog)
